children.heading: In general
children.text: The Secretary of the Treasury may subscribe on behalf of the United States to not more than 7,011,270 shares of the capital stock of the Bank.

children.heading: Effectiveness of subscription commitment
children.text: Any commitment to make such subscription shall be effective only to such extent or in such amounts as are provided for in advance by appropriations Acts.

tree.heading: Limitations on authorization of appropriations
tree.text: For payment by the Secretary of the Treasury of the subscription of the United States for shares described in subsection (a), there are authorized to be appropriated $1,050,007,800 without fiscal year limitation.

tree.heading: Limitations on obligation of appropriated amounts for shares of capital stock

children.heading: In general
children.text: Not more than $105,000,000 of the amounts appropriated pursuant to subsection (b) may be obligated for subscription to shares of paid-in capital stock.

children.heading: Fiscal year 1997
children.text: Not more than $52,500,000 of the amounts appropriated pursuant to subsection (b) for fiscal year 1997 may be obligated for subscription to shares of paid-in capital stock.

children.heading: Callable capital stock
children.text: Not more than $787,505,852 of the amounts appropriated pursuant to subsection (b) may be obligated for subscription to shares of callable capital stock.

tree.heading: Disposition of net income distributions by Bank
tree.text: Any payment made to the United States by the Bank as a distribution of net income shall be covered into the Treasury as a miscellaneous receipt.
